packageRules.description: fontdb and ttf-parser are direct dependencies and harfrust is a dev-dependency. skrifa, read-fonts and font-types are listed only so lockfile updates of the shared fontations stack are grouped with them.

harfrust is held below 0.13 because epaint (egui 0.37) declares the 0.12 line. It is a dev-dependency used only by the ligature regression test in frext/src/font.rs, which must shape with the same harfrust egui renders with; 0.13+ would also duplicate the read-fonts/font-types stack. Bump it together with the egui stack. Remove or raise once epaint's own declared harfrust requirement moves.
